task_name: Find books for and set up Father’s Day Gifts 2 campaign
task_description:
A week before Father’s Day, we will do a second campaign promoting some more books. Please find 3 books for each of these categories:

1. Books Under £15
2. Brand New Fiction
3. Bestselling Non-Fiction

Please then create the campaign. (We can always swap out books if I decide to add something different when I’m back!)

The A/B test for this email will be including subject headers vs not including subject headers. So one email variation needs to include buttons that say Books Under £15 etc. And one variation needs to not include the headers.

task_name: Find books for and set up Authors of the Month campaign
task_description:
Please find 3 authors who are particularly popular at the moment. E.g. if they have just released a new book or their book has recently been adapted to film/TV.

I did a campaign like this in April, so you can use it for inspiration - but this time we need different authors!
https://www.klaviyo.com/campaign/01KN7FX0PZAA5X4MD24B1Y7WG1/reports/overview 

You will need to choose 3 books for each author. When you write the email copy, please include a short line about each author and link to their page on the website. If an author doesn’t have their own page, you can just link to a search results page with their name. E.g. https://www.awesomebooks.com/search/advanced?q=bob%20mortimer 

The A/B Test will be author-led campaign vs book-led campaign. E.g. “This Month’s Biggest Authors” vs “3 Books Everyone Is Talking About”. You can keep the layout the same, but the email copy needs to be different in the variations. 

For the author-led version:
Focus on the authors themselves
Use the author names in the heading and copy
Include short descriptions about the authors
Use CTAs like “Browse all books by…” or “Explore the author”
For the book-led version:
Focus on the individual books instead
Lead with the story, popularity, adaptation or hype around the books
Make the book titles the main focus rather than the author names
Use CTAs like “Read the bestseller” or “Shop the book”

As laid out in the Google file you put together. 

Please don’t forget to update these homepage carousels weekly. You only need to add 1 or 2 books each time, just remember to delete the last book at the end of the carousel too!
